name: GetJSONNodeList
label: Find JSON Nodes by Key
description: Recursively searches through a JSON structure and returns all values associated with the specified key.

fields.name: JsonContent
fields.label: JSON Content
fields.description: The JSON content to begin searching. This can be a JSON string or a JToken.

fields.name: KeyToFind
fields.label: Key to Find
fields.description: The name of the JSON key to locate in the structure. Search is recursive and case-sensitive.

fields.name: ResultList
fields.label: Result List
fields.description: A list of matching JTokens found under the specified key. If no matches are found, returns an empty list.
